name: Jordan Jenkins

approach.title: Start from a real problem
approach.body: Every project answers a need I ran into in insurance, in my family, or in my club. No tutorial clones.

approach.title: Write the rules first
approach.body: Requirements, privacy and compliance limits are written down before any code, so they shape the design.

approach.title: Build with AI coding tools
approach.body: Claude Code writes much of the code. I decide what gets built, review it, and make the design calls.

approach.title: Prove it with tests
approach.body: Automated checks run before anything ships. Bugs that reach production become new tests.

approach.title: Publish the limits
approach.body: Fake data is labeled fake and untested parts are labeled untested, on every project.

learning: The Claude API (Building with the Claude API, in progress)

experience.body: Licensed in Utah and Wyoming. I explain coverage to clients in plain language and keep up with products and regulations. This work is where my software comes from: jenkinsir.com and the inquiry pipeline both started as problems I met here.
